More critically, the search strategy is flawed because the query includes "site:billboard.com", which restricts results to only that domain. Since the previous steps already showed that Wikipedia and Headline Planet confirmed the album release date (February 24, 2017), repeating a search on a single site that didn't yield the specific date in the visible snippets is inefficient. The agent should have either searched Wikipedia (which was already shown to have the info in Step 2) or searched without the site filter to find a source explicitly stating the date. This redundancy and lack of varied search strategies hinder efficient problem-solving.
